whatchanged: Replaced per-step launches for steps 1 through 128 with a direct or shared-memory tiled epoch kernel.
Fused final-state counting into the output kernel and handled periodic halos and tile tails.
Kept a scalar ping-pong fallback for longer epochs and preserved the public API header.
limitations: No GPU runtime was available; candidate output correctness was not executed against an oracle.
No timing or memory-use measurements were available, so no performance claim is made.
Only the sm_70 CPU-side CUDA build was attempted; held-out runtime cases remain unverified.
